title: [Đề 05] Bộ Đề Chuẩn Hóa B1 Số 01 — Tiêu Chuẩn CEFR B1 (Sheep Can Recognise Faces!)
description: Bộ đề luyện thi chuẩn hóa theo đúng ma trận 3 lựa chọn (A/B/C) và True/False của VNU Test Bậc 3 (ULIS). Bài đọc thực tế: Sheep Can Recognise Faces! (Part 2), Sheraton Old San Juan Hotel (Part 3), Whale-Watching Trip with Laura (Part 4).

tasks.title: Part 1: Signs & Notices
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. Choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each sign, notice, or short message.

questions.prompt:
Please note:
this afternoon’s football class will be tomorrow instead, as Mr Hall is away today.

options.text: There is no football class today.
Mr Hall can’t come to the football class tomorrow.
You can choose to go to the football class today or tomorrow.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo nêu rõ: Lớp học bóng đá chiều nay sẽ được chuyển sang ngày mai vì hôm nay thầy Hall đi vắng ('this afternoon’s football class will be tomorrow instead, as Mr Hall is away today'). Điều này có nghĩa là hôm nay không có lớp học bóng đá. Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt:
Hi Jane,
Have you finished with that book I lent you? It’s just that my brother needs it for a school project.
Thanks,
Louise

options.text: Louise is offering to lend Jane a book.
Louise wants her book back from Jane.
Louise’s brother has borrowed a book from Jane.

questions.explanationVi: Trong tin nhắn, Louise hỏi Jane đã đọc xong cuốn sách mình cho mượn chưa vì em trai của Louise đang cần cuốn sách đó cho dự án ở trường ('Have you finished with that book I lent you? It’s just that my brother needs it...'). Tức là Louise muốn nhận lại cuốn sách từ Jane. Đáp án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: dự án học tập ở trường

questions.prompt:
Picnic area
No ball games here – please use the other side of the park.

options.text: You can buy food somewhere else in the park.
Please don’t eat while you are playing sport here.
This is a place for eating and you can’t play football here.

questions.explanationVi: Biển báo tại khu vực dã ngoại ('Picnic area' - nơi ăn uống ngoài trời) quy định: Không chơi các trò chơi có bóng ở đây, vui lòng sử dụng phía bên kia của công viên ('No ball games here – please use the other side of the park'). Như vậy đây là khu vực ăn uống và không được đá bóng tại đây. Đáp án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: khu vực ăn uống dã ngoại

questions.prompt:
Museum open from 12.
Children must be with an adult.

options.text: Adults can take children to the museum in the morning.
Adults with children over 12 will enjoy the museum.
Children can visit the museum if they are with an adult.

questions.explanationVi: Biển báo ghi: Bảo tàng mở cửa từ 12 giờ trưa và trẻ em bắt buộc phải có người lớn đi kèm ('Children must be with an adult'). Do đó trẻ em có thể vào thăm bảo tàng nếu đi cùng người lớn. Đáp án C đúng.

questions.prompt:
From: Mrs Monmouth, Head Teacher
To: All Pupils and Parents

Hello,
This week, please don’t use the car to get to school. Coming on foot is healthy and doesn’t take much time.
Thanks,
Mrs Monmouth

Why has Mrs Monmouth written this message?

options.text: to ask pupils to walk to school
to tell pupils to get to school on time
to explain about a health problem at school

questions.explanationVi: Hiệu trưởng Monmouth đề nghị tuần này không đi ô tô đến trường mà hãy đi bộ vì đi bộ tốt cho sức khỏe và không mất nhiều thời gian ('please don’t use the car to get to school. Coming on foot is healthy...'). 'Come on foot' đồng nghĩa với 'walk'. Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt:
Pedro’s Pizza Bar
Buy two pizzas at the same time, and we’ll give you a third one for free! This offer is Mon–Fri only.

options.text: Pedro’s Pizza Bar isn’t open at weekends.
The third time you visit, you get a free pizza.
Three pizzas cost the same as two.

questions.explanationVi: Quảng cáo của quán Pedro’s Pizza Bar: Mua 2 chiếc bánh pizza cùng lúc sẽ được tặng miễn phí chiếc thứ 3 ('Buy two pizzas at the same time, and we’ll give you a third one for free!'). Điều này có nghĩa là mua 3 chiếc bánh chỉ tốn tiền bằng 2 chiếc ('Three pizzas cost the same as two'). Đáp án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: chương trình ưu đãi, khuyến mãi

questions.prompt:
Once opened,
keep in the coldest part
of refrigerator and
use within five days.

options.text: The product can last five days after opening.
The product should be stored in a refrigerator immediately.
The product doesn't have to be kept cool.

questions.explanationVi: Nhãn sản phẩm hướng dẫn: Sau khi mở nắp, hãy bảo quản ở ngăn lạnh nhất của tủ lạnh và sử dụng trong vòng 5 ngày ('Once opened, keep in the coldest part of refrigerator and use within five days'). Tức là sản phẩm dùng được trong 5 ngày sau khi mở. Đáp án A đúng.

tasks.title: Part 2: Cloze Test
tasks.instructions: Read the text below and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each blank from 8 to 15.

passage.title: Sheep Can Recognise Faces!
passage.text:
Many people think sheep aren’t very intelligent creatures. But in fact, (8) ________ to new research, they may be cleverer than we think. For example, sheep can actually be (9) ________ to recognise human faces from photographs!

Recognising faces is an important human social (10) ________. However, it seems that sheep are also social animals that can recognise other sheep as well as (11) ________ humans. In experiments, researchers trained eight sheep to recognise the faces of celebrities from photographs. Training involved getting the sheep to (12) ________ decisions about the photos they saw. At one end of a room, they would see two different photographs, and would receive a (13) ________ of food for approaching the photograph of the celebrity; if they approached the wrong photograph, they got nothing. Over time, they learned to (14) ________ getting food with the celebrity’s photograph. And after training, the sheep correctly chose the celebrity’s face eight times (15) ________ of ten!

questions.prompt: But in fact, (8) ________ to new research, they may be cleverer than we think.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc cố định 'according to + N' (theo như nghiên cứu mới...). Các từ 'regarding' và 'following' không đi với giới từ 'to' để mang nghĩa trích dẫn nguồn. Đáp án C đúng.

questions.prompt: For example, sheep can actually be (9) ________ to recognise human faces from photographs!
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc bị động 'be trained to do something' (được huấn luyện để nhận diện khuôn mặt người). Ngay đoạn dưới cũng lặp lại: 'researchers trained eight sheep to recognise...'. Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt: Recognising faces is an important human social (10) ________.
questions.explanationVi: Cụm từ cố định (collocation) 'social skill' mang nghĩa là 'kỹ năng xã hội'. 'Talent' (năng khiếu bẩm sinh) và 'method' (phương pháp) không kết hợp với 'social' trong ngữ cảnh này. Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt: However, it seems that sheep are also social animals that can recognise other sheep as well as (11) ________ humans.
questions.explanationVi: Tính từ 'familiar' (quen thuộc - những con người mà chúng đã từng gặp/nhìn thấy trước đó). Cừu có thể nhận ra những con cừu khác cũng như những người quen thuộc ('familiar humans'). Đáp án C đúng.

questions.prompt: Training involved getting the sheep to (12) ________ decisions about the photos they saw.
questions.explanationVi: Cụm động từ cố định (collocation) 'make decisions' (đưa ra quyết định). Không dùng 'set' hay 'do' với 'decisions'. Đáp án B đúng.

questions.prompt: ...and would receive a (13) ________ of food for approaching the photograph of the celebrity...
questions.explanationVi: Cụm 'a reward of food' mang nghĩa 'một phần thưởng bằng thức ăn' khi cừu tiến lại gần bức ảnh đúng trong quá trình huấn luyện. Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt: Over time, they learned to (14) ________ getting food with the celebrity’s photograph.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'connect A with B' (liên kết, gắn kết việc nhận được thức ăn với bức ảnh của người nổi tiếng). Đáp án C đúng.

questions.prompt: And after training, the sheep correctly chose the celebrity’s face eight times (15) ________ of ten!
questions.explanationVi: Cụm chỉ tỷ lệ chuẩn trong tiếng Anh: 'eight times out of ten' (8 trên 10 lần). Đáp án A đúng.

tasks.title: Part 3: True / False
tasks.instructions: Read the text below and decide whether statements from 16 to 20 are True or False. Choose A for True and B for False.

passage.title: Sheraton Old San Juan Hotel
passage.text:

Along with the tourism increase, new renovations have taken place throughout the entire tourism industry and the Sheraton Old San Juan has been no exception. With over $20 million to be invested by the end of 2016, the hotel will have completely remodelled all rooms and common areas with a new colour scheme of sleepy blues and divine whites, creating a fashionable yet relaxing environment. With world-class chefs and renowned barmen, you are in for a great and delicious treat. Ask our front desk and they will gladly give you a variety to choose from. Don't forget to try the traditional Puerto Rican dishes: Mofongo, Asopao and Lechon and the drinks: Pina Colada, Mojitos and our locally brewed beers.

SHERATON SWEET SLEEPER BED & AMENITIES

You can enjoy the comfort of Sheraton's Sweet Sleeper Bed in your own home. Order the complete Sweet Sleeper Bed for a restful night's sleep, every night.

Outstanding Amenities Including:
- 100% Non-Smoking Guestrooms, including outdoor balconies

- Bay or City View Rooms available
- In-Room Safe oversized for a laptop

questions.prompt: The hotel is located far away from the Old San Juan Historic District.
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn 1 nêu rõ: 'Being the only branded upscale hotel located in the heart of historic Old San Juan...' (khách sạn nằm ngay tại trung tâm khu phố cổ lịch sử Old San Juan chứ không phải ở xa). Do đó nhận định là SAI (False - B).

questions.prompt: More than $20 million will be invested in the hotel.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 1 ghi: 'With over $20 million to be invested by the end of 2016, the hotel will have completely remodelled all rooms...' ('over $20 million' đồng nghĩa với 'more than $20 million'). Nhận định là ĐÚNG (True - A).

questions.prompt: There aren't many restaurants in the Old San Juan.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 khẳng định: 'And the Old San Juan is no exception. It is filled with restaurants and with flavours.' (Khu phố cổ Old San Juan tràn ngập các nhà hàng). Vì vậy nói không có nhiều nhà hàng là SAI (False - B).

questions.prompt: It is possible to purchase the Sheraton Sweet Sleeper bed.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 3 nêu rõ: 'You can enjoy the comfort of Sheraton's Sweet Sleeper Bed in your own home. Order the complete Sweet Sleeper Bed for a restful night's sleep, every night.' Như vậy khách hàng có thể đặt mua chiếc giường này về nhà. Nhận định là ĐÚNG (True - A).

questions.prompt: Smoking is only allowed on the balcony.
questions.explanationVi: Phần tiện ích nêu rõ: '100% Non-Smoking Guestrooms, including outdoor balconies' (100% phòng nghỉ không hút thuốc, bao gồm cả ban công ngoài trời). Do đó hút thuốc bị cấm cả ở ngoài ban công. Nhận định là SAI (False - B).

tasks.title: Part 4: Reading Comprehension
tasks.instructions: Read the following passage and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each question from 21 to 25.

passage.title: Whale-Watching Trip with Laura
passage.text:
A while ago, my friend Olivia was telling me about a whale-watching trip she’d been on, in Canada. I wanted to tell her I was about to do the same thing, off the north coast of the UK, where my grandparents live. Whales had recently appeared there again, and my grandparents were convinced we’d see some – so I was sure my trip would be as good as Olivia’s! But then I saw some reviews of the trip my dad had booked for us, when no-one had seen any whales at all. So, in the end, I decided not to tell Olivia anything about my trip, in case it wasn’t successful!

Anyway, Dad and I set off on our trip – which was Dad’s idea – and it was fantastic! Travelling out to sea on the tour boat with our guide, we soon reached the spot where whales often appeared. Then we waited – and nothing happened. I was sure this wouldn’t last, though. People kept calling out they’d seen one, which was exciting – but then it turned out they were wrong. Then finally I saw something move under the water – a minke whale! So I felt like a hero for the rest of the trip!

The whale was a wonderful sight, with its huge back not far from the boat. Our guide said it was around five tonnes in weight and around 10 metres long. Yet, despite its size, it swam alongside us at speed, and with little effort. We waited to see if more appeared, and some time later, we saw three more some distance away, that kept diving under the water and coming up again. Then just after I’d filmed them, they disappeared.

Although the water’s less deep around the coast, larger whale species appear in the area with minke whales, feeding on fish. But minkes are curious creatures, so they’re more likely to approach tourist boats – which was why we were successful! Then later, up on the cliffs, we looked out to sea, searching for signs of whales. Sometimes seabirds diving into the water means whales are around, as they’re stealing the whales’ meal. We were unlucky, sadly – but we’ll be back!

questions.prompt: Jack wasn’t keen to mention his whale-watching trip to Olivia because

options.text: he thought her trip sounded a lot more exciting.
he’d read some negative reports about where he was going.
he wasn’t sure if his dad had definitely arranged it.

questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn 1, Jack kể: 'But then I saw some reviews of the trip my dad had booked for us, when no-one had seen any whales at all. So, in the end, I decided not to tell Olivia anything about my trip, in case it wasn’t successful!' (Cậu đọc được những đánh giá không tốt rằng không ai nhìn thấy cá voi nên quyết định không kể trước cho Olivia). Đáp án B đúng.

questions.prompt: On board the whale-watching boat, Jack

options.text: was proud to be the first person to see a whale.
began to worry that they might all be disappointed.
tried not to get excited when anyone saw something.

questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn 2: 'Then finally I saw something move under the water – a minke whale! So I felt like a hero for the rest of the trip!' (Jack là người đầu tiên phát hiện ra cá voi minke thật sự dưới nước nên cảm thấy tự hào như một người hùng suốt phần còn lại của chuyến đi). Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt: When Jack saw the minke whale, he was

options.text: surprised at how close it came to the boat.
amazed that it was so much bigger than he’d imagined.
impressed that it moved through the water so easily.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 3 nêu rõ: 'Our guide said it was around five tonnes in weight and around 10 metres long. Yet, despite its size, it swam alongside us at speed, and with little effort.' (Mặc dù kích thước khổng lồ, con cá voi bơi cạnh thuyền với tốc độ nhanh và rất nhẹ nhàng, tốn ít sức lực). Đáp án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: một cách nhẹ nhàng, không tốn sức

questions.prompt: Jack suggests minke whales appeared in the same area as the boat because

options.text: they knew there were plenty of fish there.
they were attracted by the arrival of the visitors.
they didn’t have to compete for food with seabirds.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 4 giải thích: 'But minkes are curious creatures, so they’re more likely to approach tourist boats – which was why we were successful!' (Cá voi minke là loài vật tò mò nên chúng thường tiến lại gần tàu du lịch của du khách). Đáp án B đúng.

questions.prompt: What would Jack text to his grandparents about the whales?

options.text: I’ll send you my video of the group of whales – they only appeared briefly, so they weren’t as interesting as the first one we saw.
I must take you up to the cliffs to look for whales – we’ve seen them every time we’ve been there, so far.
You were so sure our whale-watching trip would be a success, while I still had doubts – but you were right.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 1 nêu ông bà của Jack rất tin chắc ('my grandparents were convinced we’d see some') trong khi Jack từng nghi ngờ sau khi đọc đánh giá trên mạng, nhưng cuối cùng chuyến đi đã thành công mỹ mãn đúng như lời ông bà nói. Đáp án C đúng.

tasks.title: Part 1: Short Recordings
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. For each question, listen to the recording TWICE and choose the correct answer A, B, or C.
tasks.transcript:
1. Which dish did Mark cook in the competition?
Woman: So you’ve won the teenage chef competition, Mark – congratulations!
Mark: Thanks! In the competition, you choose whether to cook a meat, fish or vegetarian dish; then you’re judged on the taste and how attractive it looks. I couldn’t decide between fish and vegetables – I’ve never been brilliant at meat dishes. Then I found the judge was an expert in cooking fish, which worried me, so I went for my other choice – and won!

2. Where is the girl’s book now?
Girl: Excuse me. I think I left my book on this table – have you seen it?
Man: Oh yes. I took it inside with the empty glass when I cleared the table. I gave it to the manager, who put it with the other lost property. He keeps it all in the drawer of his desk.
Girl: I see. Where is he now?
Man: He’s on the phone inside the café. Why don’t you go inside – he’ll be finished in a minute.

3. Who lives with Josh in his house?
Girl: Does your house seem empty now your sister’s left home, Josh?
Josh: Not really. My grandmother’s moved into her room, and she doesn’t go out much. It’s really nice having her there because my dad never comes home until later, and if my mum’s out for the evening, Grandma cooks supper for me.

4. What will the girl take with her on holiday?
Boy: Have you packed for your holiday?
Girl: No, I need to go shopping before I can do that. Last holiday, my suitcase handle got broken, so I need something new to pull all my stuff in. But suitcases are so heavy to carry.
Boy: I always take a backpack – you can carry more that way.
Girl: Yes, I thought about one of those, but good-quality ones are expensive. I’ll get one of those big sports bags. You know, one you can pull along. They don’t cost much, so it doesn’t matter if it gets torn.

5. What time will the train to Manchester leave?
Man: The train arriving at platform six is the 11.45 from Manchester. The train due to arrive at platform four in approximately five minutes is the delayed 11.30 train to Manchester. The train will now depart at 11.50 and travel non-stop. We apologise to passengers for the delay. Refreshments will not be available on this train.

6. Where will the friends meet?
Kimberley: Hi, it’s Kimberley. I got your message and I’d love to go to the movies. There’s a film called SpyGame, or a comedy – I don’t mind which … Shall we meet outside the cinema?
Girl: Or, I know, at the burger bar on the corner. We could have a snack before we go in or we could meet at the bus station.
Kimberley: Mum’s driving me into town this afternoon, to buy some trainers, so I won’t be near the station. But something to eat first is a good idea. Shall we say 6 o’clock?
Girl: OK.

7. Which sport will the boy do soon at the centre?
Boy: Have you been to the new water sports centre yet?
Girl: Oh yes, it’s brilliant. There are two indoor pools, one for underwater diving and one for swimming, and you can also have sailing lessons on the lake.
Boy: That’s what I’m doing there next weekend, actually. I was hoping to take waterskiing lessons, but the leaflet says they’re not starting those until next year.

questions.prompt: Which dish did Mark cook in the competition?
questions.explanationVi: Mark nói cậu phân vân giữa món cá và món rau củ ('fish and vegetables') vì không giỏi nấu thịt. Khi biết giám khảo là chuyên gia về cá, cậu lo lắng nên đã chọn phương án còn lại là món chay/rau củ ('so I went for my other choice – and won!'). Đáp án C đúng.

questions.prompt: Where is the girl’s book now?

options.text: On the table outside the café
By the telephone inside the café

questions.explanationVi: Người phục vụ nói đã mang cuốn sách vào trong đưa cho quản lý cất cùng đồ thất lạc trong ngăn kéo bàn làm việc ('I gave it to the manager, who put it with the other lost property. He keeps it all in the drawer of his desk'). Đáp án B đúng.

questions.prompt: Who lives with Josh in his house?

options.text: His grandmother, his sister, and his parents

questions.explanationVi: Chị gái của Josh đã chuyển đi ('your sister’s left home'), và bà của cậu đã chuyển vào phòng của chị ('My grandmother’s moved into her room'), sống cùng bố và mẹ của Josh. Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt: What will the girl take with her on holiday?

options.text: A large sports bag on wheels

questions.explanationVi: Cô gái nói vali bị hỏng tay cầm và quá nặng, còn ba lô tốt thì đắt, nên cô quyết định mua một chiếc túi thể thao cỡ lớn có thể kéo đi ('I’ll get one of those big sports bags. You know, one you can pull along'). Đáp án B đúng.

questions.prompt: What time will the train to Manchester leave?
questions.explanationVi: Thông báo tại nhà ga: Chuyến tàu 11:30 đi Manchester bị trễ và bây giờ sẽ khởi hành vào lúc 11:50 ('is the delayed 11.30 train to Manchester. The train will now depart at 11.50'). Đáp án C đúng.

questions.prompt: Where will the friends meet?

options.text: At the burger bar on the corner

questions.explanationVi: Người bạn gợi ý gặp ở quán burger ở góc phố ('at the burger bar on the corner. We could have a snack before we go in'), và Kimberley đồng ý rằng ăn nhẹ trước là ý kiến hay ('something to eat first is a good idea. Shall we say 6 o’clock?'). Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt: Which sport will the boy do soon at the centre?
questions.explanationVi: Khi bạn nữ nhắc đến học chèo thuyền buồm trên hồ ('sailing lessons on the lake'), bạn nam nói: 'That’s what I’m doing there next weekend, actually' (Đó chính là môn tớ sẽ học vào cuối tuần tới). Lớp lướt ván nước năm sau mới mở. Đáp án C đúng.

tasks.title: Part 2: Short Conversations
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. Listen to the conversations TWICE and choose the correct answer A, B, or C.
tasks.transcript:
8. You will hear two friends talking about a film they’ve just seen.
Girl: That was a great film.
Boy: If you’re into that kind of thing. I haven’t seen anything as bad as that for a long time.
Girl: Oh, I didn’t know that you don’t like horror movies.
Boy: I usually do, but I’m not sure that’s how I’d describe that film – there was only one bit I found at all scary. It’s strange because the main characters were played by two quite big stars, but I don’t know how they got to be so famous if that’s the best they can do. It was all very disappointing …
Girl: Oh, dear!

9. You will hear two friends talking about some biology homework.
Girl: How’s your biology homework going?
Boy: Not very well. I can’t work out what I have to do.
Girl: In that case, it probably won’t be much use looking online. You can find all the information you need there, but if you don’t know what to do with it, it’s not really going to help you. Have you seen Mr Benson about it?
Boy: No, not yet.
Girl: It might be best, as he set the homework in the first place. Take your coursebook with you when you go so he can explain everything to you using that.
Boy: Good idea!

10. You will hear two friends talking about an interview with a singer they’ve seen on TV.
Girl: Did you see that interview with Denny Starr?
Boy: I did. He seemed so nervous at the beginning. And it wasn’t that the guy asking the questions was especially rude or asked him anything difficult.
Girl: I know. But once he relaxed a bit, he really spoke about lots of things I didn’t know anything about.
Boy: I don’t think I’ve ever heard him talk in so much detail about his life before. In other interviews I’ve heard, he’s generally given answers that had very little to do with what he’s been asked.
Girl: Yes, like he didn’t really understand the question.
Boy: Exactly.

11. You will hear a girl telling her friend about a diving trip.
Boy: How was the diving trip?
Girl: It was great, but I learned to dive in a swimming pool where the water doesn’t move around much. Going underwater in the sea was a completely different experience. I seemed to become totally unable to do all those things that I got so good at in the pool.
Boy: So is it something you’d like to have another go at?
Girl: I’ll think about it, but if I do, I need to make sure I go with my cousin Martin again. It gave me a bit more confidence to be underwater with someone I knew.

12. You will hear a girl talking to a friend about basketball.
Girl: Hey, did you see the big basketball game last night?
Boy: I did, yeah.
Girl: That was awesome when their star player jumped so high he nearly landed on that cameraman! Wouldn’t you love to be able to do that? You’d be a great player – you’re real tall.
Boy: I guess. I can’t say I understand much about the rules, though.
Girl: Some of them are quite complicated, especially the ones about how long you can hold onto the ball for. But the best way to understand them is to play – that way you’d learn them as you were having fun.
Boy: Maybe one day.

13 & 14. You will hear a boy talking about a trip to a city with his family.
Girl: How was London?
Boy: Great, except we got lost.
Girl: Oh no! How?
Boy: My dad had this guidebook which was at least 20 years old. We told him lots of things would be different now, so most of what was in it would be wrong. Even though it was old, it was probably more accurate than the information a guy on the street gave us for getting to Big Ben – we ended up somewhere completely different! We only used the book for getting around on the Underground in the end – the map’s almost the same as it was back then.

tasks.title: Part 3: Extended Conversation (True / False)
tasks.instructions: There are 6 questions in this part. You will hear a boy called Thomas and a girl called Ruby talking about a poster for their school sports day. Decide whether statements 15 to 20 are Correct (True) or Incorrect (False). Choose A for True and B for False.
tasks.transcript:
You will hear a boy called Thomas and a girl called Ruby talking about a poster for their school sports day.

Thomas: So, Ruby, what about this poster for the school sports day. How shall we start?
Ruby: Well, Thomas, I think we should draw a rough copy on this paper first and then do a final copy when we’ve got everything right.
Thomas: Good idea. Well, let’s get a bigger piece of paper … that paper’s too small.
Ruby: I think last year’s poster was 40 centimetres by 60 centimetres.
Thomas: That was a good size, so there’s no reason to change it and we’ll make it black and white again. I think that looks best.
Ruby: But wouldn’t it be a good idea to show that our new sports colours are purple and yellow?
Thomas: That’s a good point but think of the cost! We need to do at least 20 photocopies.
Ruby: Oh, I forgot about the money … of course. So, what shall we put at the top of the poster? Do you think we should have our school name there?
Thomas: I’d prefer it in the centre so that it’s the first thing people notice.
Ruby: That’s where the photograph should go, I think. And then we can put the date and the time underneath it.
Thomas: OK. Which picture are we going to use?
Ruby: Well, there are three here. This one of the football team isn’t very good. And this one’s too dark.
Thomas: I prefer this photo taken last week of the baseball game. It’s a very popular new sport at our school.
Ruby: Fine. So that just leaves how to write the words. Do you think we should use all capital letters?
Thomas: Let’s see … If we put the school name and address … here. They should be in capitals but there isn’t room for everything so big.
Ruby: But people need to see the date and time clearly. I know … everybody knows the school address so that can be tiny.
Thomas: OK. Let’s try it that way.
Ruby: I think it’s going to be a really good poster.

questions.prompt: Ruby realises that the first design of the poster may need improving.
questions.explanationVi: Ruby nói: 'I think we should draw a rough copy on this paper first and then do a final copy when we’ve got everything right.' (Vẽ bản nháp trước rồi mới làm bản chính thức khi mọi thứ đã ổn). Điều này cho thấy cô nhận thức bản phác thảo đầu tiên có thể cần chỉnh sửa, hoàn thiện. Đáp án A (True) đúng.

questions.prompt: Thomas thinks the poster should be bigger than last year’s.
questions.explanationVi: Khi Ruby nhắc tấm áp phích năm ngoái cỡ 40x60 cm, Thomas nói: 'That was a good size, so there’s no reason to change it' (Kích thước đó tốt rồi, không có lý do gì để thay đổi). Do đó nhận định Thomas muốn làm to hơn năm ngoái là SAI. Đáp án B (False) đúng.

questions.prompt: Ruby and Thomas agree that the poster should be in colour.
questions.explanationVi: Thomas muốn in đen trắng ('make it black and white again') vì chi phí photocopy 20 bản màu quá đắt, và Ruby đã đồng ý ('Oh, I forgot about the money … of course'). Do đó nhận định cả hai đồng ý làm áp phích màu là SAI. Đáp án B (False) đúng.

questions.prompt: Ruby thinks the photograph should be in the middle of the poster.
questions.explanationVi: Khi Thomas nhắc đến vị trí chính giữa ('in the centre'), Ruby nói: 'That’s where the photograph should go, I think.' (Mình nghĩ đó là nơi nên đặt bức ảnh). Đáp án A (True) đúng.

questions.prompt: Thomas suggests they use the same photograph as last year.
questions.explanationVi: Thomas nói: 'I prefer this photo taken last week of the baseball game.' (Tớ thích bức ảnh chụp trận bóng chày vào tuần trước hơn). Không phải ảnh của năm ngoái. Đáp án B (False) đúng.

questions.prompt: Ruby thinks every word on the poster should be the same size.
questions.explanationVi: Ruby nói: 'But people need to see the date and time clearly. I know … everybody knows the school address so that can be tiny.' (Địa chỉ trường ai cũng biết nên có thể viết cỡ rất nhỏ). Vì vậy không phải mọi từ đều có cùng kích cỡ. Đáp án B (False) đúng.

tasks.title: Task 1: Best Student of the Year Profile
tasks.instructions: Write a paragraph of at least 80 words introducing the 'Best Student of the Year' for your school magazine based on the information in the box.

writingPrompts.title: Best Student of the Year
writingPrompts.instructions: Write at least 80 words using all the provided facts in the information box.

dataCard.Name: Tran Hoang Nam
dataCard.Achievement: Won English Speaking Contest, Organized Reading Week

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: We are proud to introduce Tran Hoang Nam from Class 10A1 as our school's Best Student of the Year. Throughout this academic year, Nam has worked very hard and achieved impressive results in both his studies and school activities. Recently, he won first prize in the city's English Speaking Contest and successfully organized a Reading Week for hundreds of students in our school library. In the future, Nam plans to apply for a scholarship to study abroad in Japan so that he can learn more about modern technology and Japanese culture. He is truly a great role model for all of us.

tasks.title: Task 2: Opinion Paragraph (Choice)
tasks.instructions: Choose ONE of the two topics below and write a paragraph of at least 100 words.

writingPrompts.title: Topic Choice 2.1 or 2.2
writingPrompts.instructions: Select one topic and write a well-structured paragraph of at least 100 words.

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph about why students should learn soft skills in school.
guidelines: Helping students communicate clearly and work well in teams
Improving problem-solving and time management in daily study
Preparing young people for future jobs and real-life challenges

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph about the negative effects of using mobile phones too much.
guidelines: Causing eye strain, poor sleep, and lack of physical exercise
Distracting students from schoolwork and reducing concentration
Reducing face-to-face communication with family and friends

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: In my opinion, students should definitely learn soft skills in school alongside their traditional academic subjects. First of all, communication and teamwork skills help students express their ideas clearly, listen actively, and cooperate effectively with classmates during group projects. Secondly, learning time management and problem-solving skills allows young people to organize their busy study schedules, meet deadlines on time, and handle exam stress much better. Finally, modern employers today look for workers who can adapt quickly to changes and collaborate well with colleagues, so learning soft skills early prepares students for their future careers. In conclusion, soft skills are truly essential for both academic success at school and long-term achievement in real life.

tasks.title: Part 1: Social Interaction
tasks.instructions: Answer questions about your daily habits, hobbies, and study routine.

speakingPrompts.title: Personal Questions
speakingPrompts.instructions: Answer naturally in 25–35 seconds per question.
questions: What do you usually do after school?
What kind of books do you like reading?
Do you prefer eating at home or eating out?
What do you often do on weekends?
Do you enjoy using technology to study?

tasks.title: Part 2: Cue-Based Long Turn
tasks.instructions: Choose Card 1 or Card 2 to speak for 1.5 to 2 minutes.

cueCards.title: Describe a hobby you enjoy.
prompts: How often you do it and with whom
And explain how this hobby helps you in life
furtherQuestions: Why is it important for students to have hobbies?
Do you think hobbies that cost a lot of money are better?
cueCards.sampleResponse: A hobby that I really enjoy in my free time is playing badminton. I usually play it three times a week in the late afternoon with my best friends at a local sports centre near my house. Playing badminton helps me stay fit and active after sitting in class all day. Moreover, it is a wonderful way to reduce stress and spend fun time chatting with my friends.

cueCards.title: Talk about a time you helped someone.
prompts: What you did to help them
And explain how you felt afterwards
furtherQuestions: How can young people help elderly neighbours in their community?
Why do people feel happy when they help others?
cueCards.sampleResponse: Last month, I helped a new classmate named Minh prepare for our English mid-term exam. Because he had just moved from another province, he found the listening exercises quite difficult. We spent three afternoons in the school library practising listening tests together and reviewing vocabulary. When he passed the test with a good score, I felt very happy and proud that my support made a difference.
